source.publication: 2025 Form 760 Resident Individual Income Tax Instructions (with the 2025 Form 760)
source.section: Form 760 Lines 1-5, 8-9, 11, 12, 14-16; PDF p15 Line 4 Age Deduction and Exemptions; PDF p16 (printed Page 10) Age 65 and Older Deduction Worksheet lines 1-15; PDF p17 (printed Page 11) Taxpayers Age 65 and Older and Line 5; PDF p41 Tax Rate Schedule; Spouse Tax Adjustment Worksheet (PDF p18, printed Page 12), not applied by the projection

worked: Federal (given, not tested): Taxable Social Security (federal worksheet): gross benefits 50,000.00; provisional income = 85,000.00 + half of benefits 25,000.00 = 110,000.00; taxable = 42,500.00. Federal AGI = private pension (you) 50,000.00 + private pension (spouse) 35,000.00 + taxable Social Security 42,500.00 = 127,500.00. Federal taxable income = 127,500.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 - 2 x 1,600.00 additional for age 65 or older = 92,800.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 760 Line 1 federal AGI 127,500.00. Line 2 additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 3 = 127,500.00. Income-based age deduction (you born 1956-04-04, spouse born 1958-10-10); Age 65 and Older Deduction Worksheet: line 1 = 2; line 2 FAGI 127,500.00; lines 3-6 no conformity adjustments; line 7 taxable Social Security 42,500.00; line 8 AFAGI = 127,500.00 - 42,500.00 = 85,000.00; line 9 limit 75,000.00; line 11 excess = 85,000.00 - 75,000.00 = 10,000.00; line 12 = 2 x 12,000.00 = 24,000.00; line 14 = 24,000.00 - 10,000.00 = 14,000.00 and line 15 halves it, 7,000.00 each. The projection's income test has reduce_each_person false (the default), so the 10,000.00 excess comes off the couple's combined 24,000.00 once, as on the form. Line 4 age deduction = 14,000.00. Line 5 taxable Social Security subtracted = 42,500.00. Line 6 state refund 0.00. Line 7 Schedule ADJ subtractions 0.00. Line 8 = 14,000.00 + 42,500.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 56,500.00. Line 9 VAGI = 127,500.00 - 56,500.00 = 71,000.00. Line 11 standard deduction (Filing Status 2) = 17,500.00. Line 12 exemptions: Section A 2 x 930.00 = 1,860.00; Section B 2 x 800.00 (65 or older) = 1,600.00; total 3,460.00. Line 14 = 20,960.00. Line 15 Virginia taxable income = 71,000.00 - 20,960.00 = 50,040.00. Line 16 tax, rate schedule (PDF p41) as numbers: 720.00 + 5.75% x (50,040.00 - 17,000.00 = 33,040.00) = 720.00 + 1,899.80 = 2,619.80 (the form rounds to the whole dollar: 2,620.00). Line 17 Spouse Tax Adjustment 0.00 under the projection (see the note below). Credits none modelled or claimed, 0.00. Virginia income tax = 2,619.80. Form figure for comparison: the Spouse Tax Adjustment of 259.00 (separate VAGI less exemptions 41,270.00 and 26,270.00, the smaller over 17,000, taxable income over 34,000) gives 2,360.80; the projection's 2,619.80 is 259.00 higher because it does not apply that adjustment.
accepted_approximations: The Spouse Tax Adjustment (Form 760 Line 17), a reduction of up to 259 for a joint return where both spouses have income, is not applied.
